fix(map-quiz): keep all pins visible on each new question

visible for every question, across both MapQuizView (MapQuizSession) and

Previously quizRegion centered on the correct feature and applied a random

- centers on the pin bounding-box center, not the correct feature;

- corrects for latitude compression (cos lat) and portrait map aspect ratio
  so wide spreads don't clip horizontally;
- preserves jitter but clamps it to the slack that still keeps every pin in
  the visible rect;
- handles empty/single/coincident pins via a minimum span.

makeQuizAnnotations' signature is unchanged, so both call sites are covered

## Problem
On the map quiz, advancing to the next question often produced a zoom/region that did **not** include all the pins for the new question.

## Root cause
`MapQuizRegionHelper.quizRegion(for:correct:)` built the span from the pins' bounding box but then **centered on the correct feature** (not the bounding-box center) and applied a random ±30%-of-span offset without budgeting for it, pushing pins off-screen. The span also ignored the map's portrait aspect ratio and latitude compression, so wide east-west spreads clipped horizontally on phones.

## Fix
Replaced the region math with a pure, unit-tested `QuizRegionMath.region(fittingPins:jitter:)`:
- Centers on the **pin bounding-box center**.
- Sizes the span to fit all pins + ~18% margin.
- Reserves a vertical inset so pins aren't hidden under the top prompt / bottom feedback banner overlays.
- Corrects for **latitude compression** (`cos lat`) and **portrait map aspect ratio** so wide spreads don't clip horizontally.
- **Preserves jitter but clamps it** to the slack that still keeps every pin in the visible rect.
- Handles empty / single / coincident pins via a minimum span.

`makeQuizAnnotations`' signature is unchanged, so **both** map quiz surfaces are covered with no call-site edits:
- `MapQuizView` (via `MapQuizSession`)
- `MapLearningQuizView` (via `MapLearningSession`)

## Tests
Replaced two old-behavior tests (center-offset-from-correct, 20° floor) and added containment, clamped-jitter (every axis corner), aspect, high-latitude, bounding-box-center, and degenerate-case tests. `MapQuizRegionHelperTests` 13/13 pass; full suite `TEST SUCCEEDED`; `just lint-swift` clean.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF
